title: Rich Get Richer
instruction: Each day the feed shows the 3 creators with the most clicks so far. Watch who gets seen, then try a fix.

interventions.label: Reserve the 3rd slot for the least-shown creator
Rank by click rate (clicks per showing, smoothed) instead of total clicks
Show creators with fewer than 50 showings first

goals.text: Get Nova into the top 3 by total clicks by day 30
…while keeping at least 95% of run 1's clicks

debrief: Ranking by total clicks measures past exposure, not quality: whoever was shown first keeps winning, and the best newcomer can stay invisible forever. A little exploration, or a signal that is fair to the less-shown, breaks the loop at almost no cost.
